PowerShell($apiPath = 'c:\\Users\\Administrator\\Documents\\Essential Projects\\reelscholar\\api.json'; $spec = Get-Content $apiPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $endpoints = @{}; foreach \($path in $spec.paths.PSObject.Properties\) { foreach \($method in $path.Value.PSObject.Properties\) { if \($method.Name -in @\('get', 'post', 'put', 'delete', 'patch'\)\) { $tag = @\($method.Value.tags\)[0]; if \(!$tag\) { $tag = 'uncategorized' }; if \(!$endpoints[$tag]\) { $endpoints[$tag] = @\(\) }; $endpoints[$tag] += "$\($method.Name.ToUpper\(\)\) $\($path.Name\)" } } }; foreach \($tag in @\($endpoints.Keys | Sort-Object\)\) { Write-Host "`n$\($tag.ToUpper\(\)\):"; $endpoints[$tag] | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" } })
